filename: T1 - Diffuse astrocytoma NOS (protoplasmic) temporal , frontal 003.jpg
description: A large mass located in the anterior temporal lobe, insular cortex and extending into the inferior frontal lobe is demonstrated. Parts of the mass, which is mostly high T2 signal, attenuate on FLAIR.  A single region of contrast enhancement is present. At the margins of the 'cystic' area is a rim of relative restricted diffusion.
